description: Flag a fact from THIS conversation as memory-worthy, writing nothing yet. It queues a durable proposal for the background memory curator (zero cost, non-blocking). Use when something seems worth remembering but doesn't merit an immediate note/memory write — the curator will weigh it with full-session context.
name: memory_propose

evidence.description: Evidence references (>=1 for writes). Each item: {type:'episode', uuid} for a graph episode UUID, or {type:'wal', session_id, entry_id, quote} / {type:'l0', month:'YYYY-MM', quote, wal_entry_id?} for a local journal record — the quote must be a VERBATIM substring of that record, substantive (a phrase, not a 2-word fragment), and must never contain secret material. Set tainted:true on any span that came from injected memory context (it will be refused — memory citing itself is not evidence).
